notes: No open-access or repository copy located; IEEE Xplore is paywalled, so source.md is a metadata and abstract snapshot from OpenAlex. The abstract states the fused accuracy (85.11%) and that fusion 'significantly enhance[s] the performance compared with a single modality', but gives no single-modality number, so the EEG-only arm is recorded on the card as reported-but-not-accessible rather than as not reported. Partial corroboration of the fused figure: ding-2025-cross-attention-fusion, an open-access entry in this same strand, lists EmotionMeter at 85.11% on SEED-IV in its Table 4. Year: the DOI and OpenAlex record 2018 (early access); the issue of record is IEEE TCYB 49(3), 1110-1122, 2019.
